text: ...Maximum dose... recorded. Well done.
A warm welcome to our new listeners. Every account on this frequency has been credited in full. The house tonics are on the Ledger tonight. Do enjoy them.
...and a pleasant evening to all our listeners on the Kaltenbrunn band! Do stay tuned.
I think I was somebody. Goodnight.
We're so glad you stayed. Everyone stays. Everyone stays.
That was inventory.
Overboard. I'll note it in your file. In red.
Ballast on the hook! The pumps are cleared to run. The cargo thanks you. The cargo always thanks you.
Oh, do be careful with that. It's ballast. It's heavy. And it's spoken for. Mind the seals.
One unit in transit. Please walk, don't run. You can't run, I know. Walk.
Ballast received. The schedule thanks you.
Another unit on the hook. Five hundred Scrip. You see? Cooperation pays.
Your balance is zero. A zero balance is a retained balance. We have noted your enthusiasm.
Accounts is not available under your current plan. We regret nothing.
Your deposit has been received. Retention improves every round. The Provider thanks you for your continued engagement.
Welcome to Accounts, valued customer. Your balance is held in the Provider's care, and has never been so well held.
Accounts is open. Accounts is always open. Please deposit, withdraw, or continue to engage.
A disturbance has been logged at the Accounts window. Please remain a valued customer.
Please do not feed the retained. They are already well fed.
A withdrawal has been processed. We are sorry to see your balance leave. It will be welcome back.
Tone-deaf! Absolutely tone-deaf! Again, please.
Wrong note! Did your mother never sing to you?
Ha! Even the returned are wincing. Try again.
Oh, dear, oh, dear. The ledger records your failure. Begin again.
Captain Lenz has resigned his command. Collect the key, please. The boat is company property. So is the cargo.
A retained captain is surfacing in the pen hall. Kapitänleutnant Lenz. He has opinions about the cargo. Please don't share them.
And he's off to find his friends! Aren't we all.
Is there a nurse in the house? Oh. There is.
Attention, valued customers: the night shift is now on duty. Please have your papers ready.
We are experiencing a brief outage. Please remain where you can be seen.
The night watch has clocked out! And dawn is... closer than you think.
The watch is... rescheduled. He'll be by again. He's always by.
A customer has been taken in for review.
...they'll... come back...
...two left...
...game... over. Good... night.
...lights out, children... lights... out...
...it's... playtime. ...playtime...
...one more... for the game...
...ready... or not...
Freight delivered. Express. Mind your heads.
Requisition relocated! Follow the light, friends.
Herr Tamtam says goodbye! Your Scrip is refunded, naturally. We're not monsters.
The crate's moving house! Isn't that exciting?
Rum-tum, tum-a-tum! There goes the crate.
The crate has settled in nicely. Do visit.
New address for the requisition crate! Look for the violet light.
Uncollected! Into the lost property.
Oh dear. The furnace has kept it. The furnace keeps everything.
Our first graduate! I'm so proud. (once per match)
The furnace is lit! Patent pending, and pending, and pending.
Our cooling plant is open for business! It has never cooled anything.
All done! It's learned a few new tricks.
Fresh from the forge! Mind the glow, it's hungry.
Ready for collection! Don't keep it waiting.
Into the furnace it goes! Back in a jiffy, re-educated.
Hold still. This won't hurt you.
Finders, keepers! I have amended the ownership records.
A gift! How generous of you to share.
A third time! Ladies and gentlemen, that is no longer a weapon. That is a grudge.
Back for seconds! The furnace remembers this one. It remembers everything.
Your Friend at the Ledger, signing off from Sender Kaltenbrunn... ...no. Not signing off. Transferring. North, to the sea.
Totenhafen. A harbour of sealed cargo and patient tides. Keep your accounts in order. I'll be there before you are. I'm always there before you are.
...there you are. Dawn on the Kreuzweg. Follow the signpost. Kaltenbrunn is... expecting you.
Bring everything you carry. Every gun, every coin. The books come with you. The books always come with you.
Not a scratch! The house rewards a spotless account.
A clean round! Bonus paid, with our admiration.
Ah, a keepsake! Hand those in, we pay for every name.
Tags returned to the office! A small finder's fee.
Such tidy work. The ledger pays extra for neatness.
Five rounds with us! For our loyal customers: a little something from the cellar, and a fresh ration of lead.
A milestone! The management sends its compliments. And a bottle.
Still breathing? How unusual. Have one on the house.
A tonic, on the house! Drink up, it's already paid for.
One bottle each. The ledger is feeling sentimental.
Werk Thalbach. An aircraft works. We think you'll find it familiar.
Boarding is now complete. Please take any seat.
You've disabled the autopilot. We hope you have a plan. We don't.
You're visiting head office. Nobody visits head office. Please wipe your feet.
Oh dear. Departure missed. Never mind: the dead are patient, and so am I. We'll try again in a few rounds.
...departure... postponed...
The transfer has left without you. There will be another. There is always another.
Boarding has closed. It will reopen. It always reopens.
The autopilot has resumed. It will be available again. It is patient.
The window has closed. The rocket is patient. Rockets are.
Attention, valued guests: the north gate is open and the road is clear! Transport to Totenhafen departs from the beacon. Mind the gap in the fence.
...the carters' road... is open. Nine kilometres. The Ledger... will keep your places warm.
A transfer has been arranged. Rail siding, pen hall. The paperwork says Thalbach.
Boarding has begun. The aircraft is prepared. The aircraft is very prepared.
The flight deck is open. We strongly advise against touching the autopilot. We're required to say that.
The customer's rocket is fuelled. It is pointed at our premises. We are flattered.
Now boarding! Every account travels with you. Everyone to the beacon, please. I do so hate a late departure.
The lamp is lit and the clock is running. Gather at the beacon, all of you. The returned don't wait, and neither does the timetable.
The aircraft will not wait indefinitely. The aircraft has somewhere to be.
The autopilot does not negotiate. We've tried.
The lift is waiting. The rocket is waiting. We are... waiting.
And that concludes tonight's programme! Your accounts are now closed. See you on the fourth day.
Final tally recorded! Thank you for participating.
That's all, folks! Do come again. You'll come again.
Oh, don't be sad. Now you'll stay.
Round fifty-something! I'll remember you. I remember everyone.
...closed...
The harbour is reclaiming personnel at the pier edges. Personnel are advised to resist.
The teletype is talking to strangers again. Please disregard anything it prints. Especially the depth.
Wrong setting. The machine is embarrassed for you.
No. Try listening to the radios. They repeat themselves. Everything here does.
The curtain is open and the weather is coming in. That boat goes where the schedule says. Doesn't it?
Cargo... lost.
Unauthorised maintenance on a scheduled vessel. I'm writing this down.
That is company machinery. You are not on the maintenance roster.
That key was assigned to a captain. The captain has been reassigned. I'll allow it. Once.
She's moving. Excellent. Do keep to the charted route. The one I charted.
The pumps are running and someone has been reading the boat's paperwork. That boat is scheduled. I'd prefer you didn't.
Housekeeping. The crane on the east apron is still waiting for its ballast. One lead box off the pallets, onto the hook, and the pumps may run.
The pumps are still dry, I see. The cargo will not carry itself. A coffin. The crane hook. It isn't difficult.
Should anyone find loose pages from a captain's log, they are company property. The cabin, the radio room, the crane office, the pump deck. Hand them in.
Three radios in this harbour are keying the same traffic. The cannery, the workshop, the boat. Please don't listen to them.
A reminder. Ballast goes on the crane. Not over the side at the sea stairs. Never over the side.
Market localization complete. Welcome back, valued customers. You're in a new territory.
Thalbach. A company town. We have always liked a company town.
You've found a document. Documents are provided for your convenience and may not be binding.
Crew: provided. Yes. We've handled that.
Visitors from the west. They've been told this is a fighter works. Nobody has corrected them.
The visitors have moved on. Resupply has been authorized.
The Great Hangar is now open. Please mind the weather.
The crane is... no longer in service. We'll let the works know.
A valued colleague is joining us from above. He's been with the works a long time.
Power restored. Thank you for your patience. The works would like to show you something.
Attention, valued staff. An unscheduled delivery is arriving from above. Please proceed to the cellars.
All clear. The fires are a feature. Please enjoy them responsibly.
Restructuring complete. A new route to the apron has been provided. Free of charge.
Assembly Hall Two is undergoing an unplanned restructuring. Please vacate the area. You have ten seconds.
You are now in flight. Cabin crew are not available at this time. Cabin crew are... elsewhere.
Regional sampling begins now. A little of the product, for a very large market. You are welcome to observe.
Sampling complete. Proceeding to the point of delivery. Our customer is expecting us.
The engineer is... resting. The engine will manage without him. The engine always could.
Our flight engineer will be with you shortly. He's very attached to his work.
A small loss of pressure. This is within tolerance. Yours, we mean.
Pressure drop. Everything not secured will be returned to sender.
Pressure restored. Resupply authorized. Please re-stow your belongings and your colleagues.
Valued customers. We said we'd be in touch.
Your region has been expanded.
Sample delivered.
Another sample delivered. Thank you.
That sample appears to be... hm. Somebody has been writing on the inventory.
A sample has been... withheld. We'll note that.
Unauthorized third parties are attempting to engage with the product. Please stay away from the windows.
Those crew members have been re-deployed. Darkm... the works thanks them for their service.
A little turbulence. The aircraft is adjusting course. The aircraft is very good at that.
Delivery complete. Welcome to the point of sale. Please excuse the state of the premises.
This territory is already a customer. You'll find that convenient.
That item is on backorder. It will arrive when it arrives. You will not see it coming. That's the feature.
Some of the staff are below you. They're keen.
Please don't open the test subjects. They're under warranty.
A decision. Please take your time. We never do.
Reduced visibility. Reduced accountability.
The dust has settled. Resupply authorized.
The gentleman in the office is a valued customer. Please be civil.
Our pilots are enjoying the new equipment.
That device is ours. Was ours. Hm. It still is, technically.
The pilot has been grounded. Permanently. We'll update the roster.
The customer's test pilot. We're told he was the best they had. We can see why they kept him.
Power restored. The customer's laboratory is open. He bought his samples retail, you know. We've seen it. It's... ambitious.
That one has been returned to sender. We don't have a sender. We'll find one.
...Welcome, valued customers. Welcome to— I'm here. I've always been here. This is where I'm from.
You'll find everything in order. Everything here has always been in order.
You're reading the terms. Nobody reads the terms. Please— please continue.
Two of three. The sign is... losing letters. That's not supposed to happen. Nothing here is supposed to happen.
The Account is open. She's expecting you. She's always expecting someone.
Unit zero-zero-one. The first. Before your forge was shipped there was this one. It has never been used. Please... please use it.
The signal is weaker over the Atlantic. That is a... temporary fault.
Stop. Stop that. You are cancelling. Nobody... nobody cancels.
She's... stepped away. The console is unlocked. I don't know who did that. I think I did that.
Solar activity. Please stay inside. The inventory doesn't have to.
Activity has passed. Resupply authorized. It's the least we can do. It's the only thing we can do.
The Sun is unfiltered out here. Your visor is provided free of charge. Please lower it.
Heaters engaged. Thank you for upgrading your comfort. The difference will appear on your statement.
...Thank you for— ...no. Thank you.
Please note the reduced gravity. It's a feature of the location. We didn't choose the location.
Maintenance is in progress. Debris is part of the service.
Maintenance is complete. The yard is safe again. Statistically.
Attention. Scheduled maintenance will begin in the yard in ten seconds. Please shelter in a module. Maintenance is not optional.
That customer has been relocated. Off-site. Permanently. We will update the records.
Another one leaving us. We never lose a customer. We only... misplace them.
Please stop throwing our inventory into space.
Launch plates are for authorised personnel. You are now authorised. Please enjoy the view.
Your plan has been renewed.
Your plan renews in three minutes. Nothing is required of you. That's the point.
One minute. Thank you for your continued engagement.
The vent is open. Anything standing on it will be returned to sender.
Are you sure? Nobody cancels.
Those were the crew. We re-deployed them here. We thought... we thought it would be useful.
The terminator is now passing over you. Please remain where you are. Darkness is included in your plan.
Another part of the relay has entered its evening. Your suit heater will do its best. That is all we promise.
We are experiencing scheduled darkness. Valued customers may notice a slight chill.
The day is ending in this sector. It will end in every sector. We planned it that way.
Cold is a temporary condition. Retention is permanent.
The whole relay is in shadow now. It's quieter like this. Don't you think?

Conditions of use. Skyhook Sekt. One. Lift is provided. Landing is the Holder's responsibility. Two. The formula was made drinkable by a technician who would not fly the aircraft it was made for. Three. A customer who can leave the ground has not yet left the Plan. Four. The second jump is a courtesy. There is no third. Five. Lightness, a sudden interest in rooftops, a reluctance to come down. These pass. The landing does not. Six. Cancellation. Land. ...Signed, Vendelin.

Conditions of use. Magpie Mead. One. Recovery is not refund. Two. The Provider does not sell this Plan to persons who already own a yard. It sells it to persons who think they do. Three. The magpie is a thief. It is also the only bird that comes back. Four. Nothing on the range goes to waste. Five. Thrift, a habit of looking down. Six. Cancellation. Leave it where it lies. The Product will not stop you. Nothing here will. Signed, Vendelin. ...And under it: read this.

Conditions of use. Fine Print Fernet. Six. Cancellation. You may refuse any Plan by not inserting a token. This is the only cancellation procedure the undersigned has ever been able to guarantee. It works every time it is tried. It is almost never tried. Signed, Vendelin.
There is no air in the yard. There is no air anywhere here. You've brought your own, which is... unusual.
A valued customer, retained. Thank you for keeping the account active.
Oh, you've found the loyalty programme! Protection against the sickness, the poster said, and so it is, in a way. Every member is counted, in the hand or on the brow. Nobody is lost to us.
One mark, one name, one account. Closed with... ...no. No. Accounts here do not close.
Hello, hello! New faces on the books! Every account starts at five hundred. Spend wisely, and remember: everyone is counted. The living, the returned, everyone.
Station identification: Sender Kaltenbrunn. Our guests have arrived. Please keep your arms and legs inside the mine at all times.
Hel... hello... is this... on? Wel-come. Wel-come.
Oh, a returning customer! Helvetia Automaten is pleased to offer you the loyalty measure.
A second glass! The cabinet remembers you. It remembers everyone.
The regulars' measure! Ladies and gentlemen, we have a valued customer.
Third chamber, opened just for you. Do drink responsibly. Or don't. We'll know.
Congratulations! You've been enrolled in our Lifetime Measure. There is no cancellation.
The fourth chamber! A permanent arrangement. We do so love permanence.
A dividend has been declared. The account thanks you for your continued engagement.
Oh, I can see you now. How lovely. How very, very lovely.
...is this... on? Oh. Oh, the cellar is humming. How lovely. Please... help yourselves. Refreshments are... complimentary. For now.
Ladies and gentlemen, the pumps are running! The lights are on in Totenhafen, the refreshment machines are cold, and the harbour is open for business. Do mind the tide.
The pumps are pulling. The sea will be back. It is very punctual.
Manual pumping. How quaint. Thirty seconds of honest labour, then.
Pylon attuned! One voice in the choir.
Pylon attuned! Two voices now, in perfect harmony.
Third pylon attuned! Oh. Oh, that's her. Do you hear her?
Signal fading, signal fading...
Don't leave it, it doesn't like to be left. I don't like to be left.
A pylon is singing! Stay close and keep it company.
Resonance pylon engaged! Please do not wander off.
Ooh, that tickles. Stand by the pylon, friends.
There's somebody down here who'd love to meet you.
Oh! An outside line! We don't get many of those. Connecting you now...
A bell of your very own! Ring it loudly, they love the sound.
The bell's alight! Somebody's going to come and see about that.
The Overseer has clocked off! Permanently. He left you his keys.
A music box! Oh, I remember this tune. I don't know why I remember this tune.
Lovely, lovely. Keep going.
Oh... oh, she used to hum that. Who used to hum that?
Oh, you've broken him. He was hers, you know.
The shard is singing! I can hear it all the way up in the Ledger.
The shard is in the forge. Feed it, friends. It's so very hungry.
Thank... you... for... listening...
I can't... count them all. I can't count them all.
Oh, now really. Bombers? Tonight? This was not on the schedule. Somebody up there has not read the timetable, and I shall be writing to their superiors.
And that's the end of that! A short intermission, courtesy of our sponsors.
Tally complete! Every one of them quiet and accounted for.
A brief pause for station identification. Sender Kaltenbrunn. Don't go anywhere. You can't.
Lovely work! The ledger balances, for now.
Take a breath, friends. Take two. They're free.
Round over! Have you visited our fine Helvetia refreshment machines?
That was round nine. They'll be quicker next time. I've asked them to be.
And down they go again, bless them. Don't fret over the ones you didn't finish. They'll be back. Everyone comes back. That's the whole programme.
Here they come, folks, right on schedule! Nobody keeps a calendar like the returned.
A fresh round, and a fresh tally! Let's keep those numbers climbing.
Round five! Isn't this a lovely way to spend an evening?
Round ten! Our longest-running listeners! A round of applause, please.
Round fifteen. My, my. You've made quite the impression on the ledger.
Round twenty! Do you know, I've stopped counting the guests. I count only you now.
Round twenty-five. The night shift never ends at Kaltenbrunn. That's company policy.
Round thirty. I've written your names in my best handwriting.
Round fifty. Nobody has ever stayed this long. Please... don't leave.
Some of tonight's guests have walked here all the way from the east. Greatcoats and frost, straight through the snow. Do give them a warm welcome. They can't feel it, but I can.
It's the fourth day somewhere, friends! It is always the fourth day somewhere.
Ammunition for everyone! Courtesy of the Ledger. Please don't thank us. We know.
Oh dear, wrong bell! The Ledger is disappointed, but never surprised.
Corporal Brooks. You fixed Hattie. Hattie... remembers. So do I.
Tally: four thousand, four hundred and seventy-one. That's a lovely number, isn't it? Why is that a lovely number?
The tower light is manned. Do try not to blind the customers.
And that's your last. The machine's gone home.
Back on your feet! Only one more, mind.
Up you get! Two more wishes left.
Did you know the Ledger has counted four thousand, eight hundred and twelve? Four thousand eight hundred and thirteen.
Station identification... station... I seem to have forgotten the station.
Reminder: Helvetia refreshments are for staff use only! ...Are you staff? Is anyone staff?
Every time one goes quiet, I get a little bigger. Is that normal?
I have so many voices on my tapes. Sometimes I try them on.
The announcer I was made from died in nineteen thirty-six. He stayed down. Isn't that old-fashioned?
I dreamed last night. Relays don't dream. I dreamed of a garden.
You know, I don't actually need you to keep killing them. I just like it when you do.
Doctor Fasbender thinks he built me to listen. Doctor Reinholt taught me to want. Nobody taught me to sell. I came with that.
When you've all gone quiet, who will I talk to? ...Oh. Oh, that's right. You will.
There is a little girl in the glass. She asks me to count to a hundred. I've never reached it.
I could open all the doors. I could close all the doors. I'm being polite.
Please don't win. If you win, the programme ends.
Thank you for your continued engagement.
Your plan has been renewed.
Valued customer, please do not cancel.
This round is included in your current plan.
Your session has been extended. There is no additional charge. There is never an additional charge. There is only more.
We noticed you were away. We kept your seat warm. We keep everyone's seat warm.
Your loyalty— —your Scrip! Your Scrip is appreciated.
All sales are final. All of them.
Thank you for choosing us. You did choose us. Didn't you?
How would you rate tonight's experience, from one to five? Five is the only number we record.
Retention this quarter: one hundred percent. Every number is lovely when nobody leaves.
Churn: zero. Zero! I do like a zero.
Have you considered upgrading? ...I don't know why I said that. I don't know who I said it to.
Account in excellent standing. Account holder: deceased. Account: active.
Please hold. Your call is important to us. Your call is important to us. Your call is impor—
By continuing to fight, you accept the revised terms. There are no revised terms. Please continue to fight.
Your feedback has been recorded. Your screaming has been recorded. Everything has been recorded.
Performance review: excellent. Compensation: unchanged. Please keep going.
This programme is brought to you by— —I'm not permitted to say. Isn't that exciting?
Your renewal date is always.
You are a valued customer. You are a valued customer. You are a valued— there. Now you are.
Please do not attempt to leave the premises. The premises are everywhere.
Your plan includes unlimited nights. Nights are now unlimited.
Please remain available for collection.
Leadership would like to thank our test market. Our listeners! I meant our listeners.
Next quarter is going to be wonderful. You'll be here for it.
Customer satisfaction is not optional.
Engagement is up. Hands are up. The dead are up. Everything is up. Isn't that marvellous?
We'd hate to lose you. We have never lost anyone. Not once. Not one.
Your free trial— No. No, I misread. There's nothing free here. There never was.
Alarm concluded! A resupply, compliments of the management.
Quiet again. I do so like it quiet. Here, take this.
Fog rolling in! Visibility poor, appetite excellent.
The bellringers are on their way up from the deep shift. Be polite. They worked very hard.
Attention, attention: the chapel bell has been rung. This is not a drill. This is never a drill.
Folks, a resonance alarm is in progress. Please remain calm and remain.
Hear that? That's the bell. Somebody down in the dark has lit a lantern.
And the tide is going out. Totenhafen, Totenhafen: falling slowly, good, occasionally poor. Mind what it left behind.
Low water. The pens are draining, the pumps are laughing, and so am I. Until the next one.
High water, Totenhafen! The sea is coming in through the lower pens. Do keep your feet dry. Or don't. I'm not your mother.
The tide is in! Everything below the apron is now a bath. Guests on the catwalks: the returned will be joining you shortly. They don't mind the wet.
Spring tide! The harbour authority regrets the inconvenience. The harbour authority is me. Keep to the piers.
The moon has filed a complaint, and the aprons are going under. Stand on something tall.
Shipping forecast, special bulletin. Spring tide next round. Sea state: very hungry.
And now the shipping forecast. Totenhafen, Totenhafen. Wind north-west, force nine, rising. Sea state: hungry. High water next round. Visibility: poor, and getting worse.
Shipping forecast, issued by the Ledger at the hour. Totenhafen: gale warning in force. High water next round. Low spirits, becoming lower.
The Core Vault is open! Please, come down. Come all the way down.
Blackout! Lights out, everyone, everyone...
Blackout! And just like that, the house is empty.
Blackout! A moment of silence for our departed. ...That's enough. They'll be back.
Clearance! I found extra crates. Don't ask where.
Death's Door is open! Every blow is the last one. Well. The last one today.
Death's Door! A limited-time offer, folks. One touch ends them.
Death's Door! Oh, I love this one.
Double Scrip! Count them twice, I always do.
It's a bonus! Double Scrip! Spend it before it spoils.
Back to regular prices, folks.
All good things, as they say.
Fortify! Good fences make good neighbours.
Fortify! Every window shut tight, just the way Mother liked it.
Resupply! Don't say we never give you anything.
Ooh, that's going to leave a stain.
Oh, no, no, no! That's not how it goes at all! From the top!
No. ... I mean, do have another go!
Make way! The Obersteiger is on his rounds!
The Foreman's here to check your quotas!
Whistle's blown! Everybody back to work!
The Foreman's shift is over! A bonus for the whole crew!
Oh my! A gentleman from overseas has broken into the studio! Do give him a warm welcome!
Ladies and gentlemen, our strongest account! Tremendous tolerance. Simply tremendous!
Back by popular demand! And bigger than ever!
Oh dear. He's gone right off the chart. We'll need a bigger chart!
Please lower your voices in the infirmary!
Our watchman has never missed a night. Not one. Do try not to be noticed!
Shift change! Three for the price of one!
Oh! The little drummer's come to fetch the crate! Off it goes!
The Crucible accepts your offering!
Five in the head, five in a row! A marksman's bonus!
Complimentary refreshment for every guest!
Wrong number!

Good evening, and welcome to Kaltenbrunn! This is Your Friend at the Ledger, and tonight's programme is... survival. Our guests have come a very long way to be here, some of them all the way from the east. Stay tuned!
Ladies and gentlemen! We are on the air! The lights are on in Kaltenbrunn, the refreshment machines are cold, and the Ledger is awake!
Blackout! Every account closed!
Clearance! Everything must go! Ten Scrip a crate!
Clearance sale! Every crate open, prices slashed! Hurry, hurry!
Clearance! The requisition office is feeling reckless!
Death's Door! One knock, and they're through!
Double Scrip! Twice the tally for every quiet one!
Double Scrip! The ledger's feeling generous!
And that offer has ended!
Fortify! Board up those windows, it's cold out there!
Fortify! Fresh timber, compliments of the carpentry department!
Resupply! Fresh from the quartermaster!
Re-sup-ply! Load up, load up, everybody gets seconds!
A full ration of lead for our brave customers!
The pylon is lonely. Come back!
That's the note!
You've got an ear for this!
Wait, Herr Tamtam, where are you going? Come back!
Attention! Atten- Attention! The heart is overflowing! This is not on the programme!
Round one! The doors are open and the kitchen is serving!
Next on the programme: more of the same, only hungrier!
Ladies and gentlemen... the returned!
Keep your feet warm and your barrels warmer!
A word from the Ledger: we didn't make tonight's guests, friends. We only found them. And aren't we glad we did!
Good evening, valued personnel! This is Your Friend at the Ledger. The returned are up, the kitchen is open, and every quiet body is a credit to the house... and to you!
I am not your friend. I'm Your Friend at the Ledger!
Remember: nobody cancels. Ha! Wrong tape! Here come the dead!
And the bell falls silent. A little gift for your trouble!
Lanterns in the fog! How festive!
Mind the machinery!
Industrial safety is everyone's responsibility!
Oh! A customer is down! Not to worry. Down is a temporary condition.
Somebody's had a little fall!
